accuracy_rules: The Mac warning stays in English: exactly 'Storage almost full.'
Every spoken line is Spanish. No English VO with Spanish subtitles.
Noah did NOT measure the iCloud quota - never claim iCloud was proven full.
Noah did NOT free storage, move files, change settings, or fix the warning.
Captions are generated from 'spoken' verbatim - never retyped by hand.
